Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.scene

Class SceneCombinationStore

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.analysis.scene.SceneCombinationStore
@Component public class SceneCombinationStore extends Object
Repository for managing and querying collections of scene combinations.

This class serves as a centralized storage and query interface for SceneCombination objects. It provides methods to find combinations based on specific criteria such as scene indices or images. This is particularly useful in state detection algorithms where you need to find all combinations that involve a particular scene or image.

The class maintains an internal list of scene combinations and provides various query methods to filter and retrieve relevant combinations based on different criteria.

  • Method Details

    • addSceneCombinations

      public void addSceneCombinations(List<SceneCombination> sceneCombinations)
      Adds multiple scene combinations to the repository.

      This method appends the provided scene combinations to the internal list. The combinations are added in the order they appear in the input list.

      Parameters:
      sceneCombinations - List of SceneCombination objects to add. Must not be null. Can be empty.

    • getAllWithScene

      public List<SceneCombination> getAllWithScene(int sceneIndex)
      Retrieves all scene combinations that include a specific scene.

      This method searches through all stored combinations and returns those where either scene1 or scene2 matches the provided index. This is useful for finding all combinations that involve a particular scene, which helps in understanding how that scene relates to other scenes in the system.

      Parameters:
      sceneIndex - The index of the scene to search for. Can be any valid integer.
      Returns:
      A new list containing all SceneCombination objects that include the specified scene index. Returns an empty list if no matches are found.

    • getAllWithSceneAndImage

      public List<SceneCombination> getAllWithSceneAndImage(int sceneIndex, StateImage stateImage)
      Retrieves scene combinations that contain both a specific scene and image.

      This method performs a two-step filtering process: first finding all combinations that include the specified scene index, then filtering those to include only combinations that also contain the specified image. This is particularly useful for finding combinations where a specific image appears in a specific scene context.

      Parameters:
      sceneIndex - The index of the scene to match. Can be any valid integer.
      stateImage - The StateImage to match. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A new list of SceneCombination objects that contain both the specified scene and image. Returns an empty list if no matches are found.

    • getSceneCombinationIndices

      public Set<Integer> getSceneCombinationIndices(List<SceneCombination> sceneCombinations)
      Extracts all unique scene indices from a list of scene combinations.

      This method collects all scene indices (both scene1 and scene2) from the provided combinations and returns them as a set, ensuring each index appears only once. This is useful for determining which scenes are involved in a given set of combinations.

      For example, if the input contains combinations [1-2, 1-3, 1-5], the result would be the set {1, 2, 3, 5}.

      Parameters:
      sceneCombinations - List of SceneCombination objects to process. Must not be null. Can be empty.
      Returns:
      A Set containing all unique scene indices found in the combinations. Returns an empty set if the input list is empty.

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a string representation of all stored scene combinations.

      Each combination is represented on a separate line using its toString() method. This is useful for debugging and logging purposes to see all combinations currently stored in the repository.

      Overrides:
      toString in class Object
      Returns:
      A string containing all scene combinations, with each combination on a separate line. Returns an empty string if no combinations are stored.

    • getAllImages

      public List<StateImage> getAllImages()
      Retrieves all images from all stored scene combinations.

      This method collects all StateImage objects from every scene combination in the repository. Note that the same image may appear multiple times in the returned list if it exists in multiple combinations. The images are added in the order they appear in each combination.

      Returns:
      A new list containing all StateImage objects from all combinations. May contain duplicates. Returns an empty list if no combinations are stored or if all combinations have no images.
